title: Janice Fraser is teaching a workshop from the book — 'a clarion call and a roadmap for building companies that don't get consumed by the greedy wealth-suckers'
summary: Fraser wrote Farther, Faster, and Far Less Drama and co-founded Adaptive Path. She set the book inside a fifty-year project to transform capitalism and rebuild civic institutions, and announced a sixty-minute workshop with an AMA, with ten free places.
blockquote: Eric Ries's book INCORRUPTIBLE is a clarion call and a roadmap for building companies that don't get consumed by the greedy wealth-suckers.

source_urls.label: Fraser two days later, at 42 reactions — 'I've started 7 companies at this point, and I will never again do a Delaware C'

attribution_title: Author of Farther, Faster, and Far Less Drama · co-founder, Adaptive Path
